description: This file defines the 'FormattingHelpActivity' class, an Android activity that displays markdown-formatted help content related to text formatting, likely in a note-taking or editing application. It includes methods for building markdown help strings, setting up UI components, and applying branding styles.

classes.name: FormattingHelpActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that shows help information for text formatting, using markdown strings and applying branding styles.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates layout, sets content, and configures formatting help content based on user preferences.

methods.name: buildContextBasedFormattingHelp
methods.description: Builds markdown string for context-based formatting help.

methods.name: buildFormattingHelp
methods.description: Builds detailed markdown string explaining various text formatting options.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to the activity UI components.
